recognize_zh: 低倍下整張抹片的紅血球聚成大小不一、不規則的團塊（凝集，agglutination），而不是錢串狀排列；高倍可見大型反應性淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣深藍並貼附紅血球，符合傳染性單核球增多症合併冷凝集素。
features: Low power: diffuse, irregular clumps of red cells of varying size throughout the smear (agglutination)
High power: red cells aggregated in amorphous three-dimensional clusters, not linear rouleaux stacks
Large reactive (atypical) lymphocytes with moderate-to-abundant cytoplasm and basophilic peripheral rim
Reactive lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei, relatively condensed chromatin and cytoplasmic hugging of adjacent red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows prominent irregular clumps of red cells distributed throughout the film, with scattered leukocytes. At high power the red cells form amorphous agglutinates rather than rouleaux, and there are large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm showing basophilic rims and scalloping around adjacent erythrocytes. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination due to cold agglutinins (typically anti-i) in the setting of infectious mononucleosis; a warmed sample should be used for accurate red cell indices.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells resembling coins, whereas agglutination forms irregular grape-like clumps that disperse on warming.
Morphology of agglutination is identical (anti-I rather than anti-i); discrimination relies on serology and absence of reactive EBV lymphocytosis.
Occurs in older adults with a monoclonal IgM kappa and a small clonal B-cell population rather than polyclonal reactive lymphocytes.
Overlapping red cells in thick areas are evenly crowded, not discrete clumps separated by clear spaces in the thin feathered edge.
